lines.t: Breath of the Endless Sky
Knowledge unsearchable
Flowing by
The laws of stars and dust obey
Every moment formed by the ancient of days
I am small yet you know my name
Maker of wonders, worlds inflamed
From shadow to light, you remain
Master of the known, the unknown reign
Marble and mystery, depths of your mind
No wisdom like yours will ever unwind
Creation in motion, the heavens awake
Heart of the universe
Yahushua's your name
Thank you.
With love you paint the dawn
Bringing light from the depths we've drawn
Hidden places shine
Revealed by wisdom alone
Mysteries unsealed
From the dust I rise with hope
To search the heights beyond my scope
In every law, in every grace
I see reflections of your face
Hey, marvel in mystery, depths of your mind
No wisdom like yours will ever I find
Creation in motion, the heavens awake
Heart of the universe
Never to break
Breathe out life
Breathe out truth
Vast and ancient, always new
Master of the known, the unknown roaring
I stand in wonder
Yahoah, what's your name?
Thank you.
